description: List the vault's meeting notes: notes linked to a calendar-event occurrence by their frontmatter (`event`, `event_series`, `event_date`), one per occurrence, a recurring meeting's notes sharing one series key. Newest first, each with path, event, series and date. Filter with series (a listed note's `series` value) and from/to (inclusive YYYY-MM-DD). Set open_items:true to add each note's open action items as task records (its own open task lines plus the open task files it links). To get ONE meeting's action items with its series history, pass note (a listed `path`) or event (a listed `event`) instead: the answer groups that meeting's items and every earlier occurrence's (dated before it, never itself; the app's "still open from earlier" rule) by occurrence, oldest first, each item a task record plus `open`. Open items only unless include_closed:true. note/event do not combine with series/from/to/open_items. Read a note's body with read_note. Read-only.

event.description: The same, by the occurrence key (a listed note's `event`).

from.description: Only notes dated on or after this day, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

include_closed.description:
With note/event: include done and cancelled items too (each item
carries `open`). Default false: open items only.

note.description:
One meeting's action items with its series history, by the meeting
note's vault-relative path (a listed note's `path`). Returns that
note's items and every earlier occurrence's, grouped by occurrence,
oldest first. Not combined with series/from/to/open_items.

open_items.description:
Add each note's open action items as task records: its own open task
lines plus the open task files it links. Default false (no task scan).

series.description:
Only notes of this series: the `event_series` value (or the vault's
renamed key) of any note in it, as a listed note's `series` shows.

to.description: Only notes dated on or before this day, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

name: list_meeting_notes
